meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会在你构建或改动界面后自行截图或捕获终端画面,运行像素对比与终端宽度检查脚本,再派出两个只读检查员分别核对设计系统完整性和视觉/CJK 缺陷,最后汇总成一个合格/不合格的结论。
howto.when: 在构建或改动任何 UI 之后,或被要求判断页面、组件、终端界面是否正常时触发。也会在你提到截图对比、设计系统检查、CJK 文字截断等关键词时进入。

say.text: 我刚改完了登录页的样式,帮我做一次视觉 QA。
say.note: Claude 会截图当前页面并运行对比检查。

say.text: 对比一下实现和这张参考图,CJK 文字有没有截断。
say.note: 会生成 diff 报告并派审查员检查。

say.text: 这个终端界面的边框对齐吗?做一次 TUI 视觉检查。
say.note: 会用真实终端渲染并检查宽度和错位。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude captures UI screenshots or terminal output, runs pixel/width diff scripts, dispatches two read-only reviewers (design-system and visual/CJK), then gives a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after you build or change any UI, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks correct. Also enters on keywords like screenshot diff, design-system check, CJK text clipping, etc.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page style. Please run a visual QA.
say_en.note: Claude captures the page and runs diff checks.

say_en.text: Compare the implementation with this reference image; check CJK text for clipping.
say_en.note: It generates a diff report and dispatches reviewers.

say_en.text: Does this terminal layout align? Run a TUI visual check.
say_en.note: It renders in a real terminal and checks width/alignment.
